scripts.build: npm run build:ui && npm run build:electron
scripts.test: node scripts/build-electron.mjs && node scripts/test-desktop-pipeline.mjs && node scripts/test-indexer-worker.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc --build && npx tsc --noEmit -p artifacts/document-discovery/tsconfig.json && npx tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck --target es2022 --moduleResolution bundler --esModuleInterop --strict electron/*.ts
